notes: Fix: crash when opening an invoice / editing an invoice-sourced loan row (hook-order regression in v0.1.39). Invoice suspense knock-off now only offers suspense dated before the invoice (no retroactive settling) and no longer shows/glows on paid read-only invoices. Loan View/Update filters no longer shift when used; date fields narrowed, Name selector fixed, Clear button space reserved. Mild row-hover highlight on all tables.
